Search 212 slides and 433 pages of course text

The search page runs entirely in the browser. It reads a static JSON index built by build.mjs from the rendered slides and the mirrored course notes; there is no server and no build step when you open it.

Provenance

Source & navigation

What is indexed

  • The visible text of all 212 slides in the 14 decks, taken from the rendered HTML
  • The mirrored course text: the notes under course/notes and the slide transcripts under course/slides
  • Speaker notes are excluded - only what a reader sees is indexed

How a result links

  • A slide hit links to decks/<deck>.html#/N - the deck, at that slide
  • A course-text hit links to the deck built from that file, and to the slide that carries the same words
  • The index is a static file: search-index.json, next to this page

Provenance. The search index is generated by build.mjs and committed alongside the page, so the page keeps working with no server and no build step at view time.
